mapper.select: SELECT r.RECIPE_ID, r.TITLE, r.SOURCE_TYPE, r.CHANNEL_NAME, r.VIDEO_URL, r.THUMBNAIL_URL, r.COOK_TIME_MIN, r.DIFFICULTY, r.SERVINGS, r.ONE_PAN_YN, r.MICROWAVE_YN, r.SCORE_WEIGHT, r.VIEW_COUNT, r.CREATED_AT, NVL(ROUND(AVG(e.RATING), 1), 0.0) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(e.EVAL_ID) AS EVAL_COUNT FROM RECIPES r LEFT JOIN RECIPE_EVALUATIONS e ON r.RECIPE_ID = e.RECIPE_ID WHERE r.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} GROUP BY r.RECIPE_ID, r.TITLE, r.SOURCE_TYPE, r.CHANNEL_NAME, r.VIDEO_URL, r.THUMBNAIL_URL, r.COOK_TIME_MIN, r.DIFFICULTY, r.SERVINGS, r.ONE_PAN_YN, r.MICROWAVE_YN, r.SCORE_WEIGHT, r.VIEW_COUNT, r.CREATED_AT
SELECT INGREDIENT_ID, RECIPE_ID, INGREDIENT_NAME, AMOUNT, UNIT, IS_ESSENTIAL, IS_BASIC_SAUCE FROM RECIPE_INGREDIENTS WHERE RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} ORDER BY IS_BASIC_SAUCE ASC, INGREDIENT_ID ASC
SELECT STEP_ID, RECIPE_ID, STEP_ORDER, INSTRUCTION, TIMER_SECONDS, TIP FROM RECIPE_STEPS WHERE RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} ORDER BY STEP_ORDER ASC

SELECT r.RECIPE_ID, r.TITLE, r.SOURCE_TYPE, r.CHANNEL_NAME, r.VIDEO_URL, r.THUMBNAIL_URL, r.COOK_TIME_MIN, r.DIFFICULTY, r.SERVINGS, r.ONE_PAN_YN, r.MICROWAVE_YN, r.SCORE_WEIGHT, r.VIEW_COUNT, i.INGREDIENT_ID, i.RECIPE_ID AS ING_RECIPE_ID, i.INGREDIENT_NAME, i.AMOUNT, i.UNIT, i.IS_ESSENTIAL, i.IS_BASIC_SAUCE FROM RECIPES r LEFT JOIN RECIPE_INGREDIENTS i ON r.RECIPE_ID = i.RECIPE_ID ORDER BY r.SCORE_WEIGHT DESC, r.RECIPE_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECIPES ( TITLE, SOURCE_TYPE, CHANNEL_NAME, VIDEO_URL, THUMBNAIL_URL, COOK_TIME_MIN, DIFFICULTY, SERVINGS, ONE_PAN_YN, MICROWAVE_YN, SCORE_WEIGHT, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{sourceType}, #{channelName}, #{videoUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{cookTimeMin}, #{difficulty}, #{servings}, #{onePanYn}, #{microwaveYn}, 1.0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE RECIPES SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId}
